label: FP
reason: Alert 1 (path-injection) is a False Positive. Although user input flows into the path resolution, the code enforces a strict containment check: `if (resolved.startsWith(base))`. Since both `base` and `resolved` are normalized, any attempt to traverse outside `/data` (e.g., using `..`) will cause `resolved` to fail the `startsWith` check, preventing execution of the sink `Files.readAllBytes(resolved)`. The resolved sink value is guaranteed to be within `/data` on the executed path.

evidence.note: Guard clause `if (resolved.startsWith(base))` ensures sink `Files.readAllBytes(resolved)` only executes if path stays within `/data`.
